faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does the sticker need charging or a battery?
faq.a1: No, the sticker works entirely with wireless power generated from phone contact (NFC) for life without any charging.
faq.q2: Does it work on all phones?
faq.a2: It works on all modern iPhone and Android devices that support NFC with a simple tap.
faq.q3: If I change my data or menu prices, does the sticker break?
faq.a3: Not at all! The sticker continues to work efficiently for life without needing replacement. If you change prices or data, you can request an update through our support, and we will remotely update your link immediately.
faq.q4: Is shipping available to all governorates?
faq.a4: Yes, we ship to all Egyptian governorates (27). Shipping cost & delivery time are confirmed manually on WhatsApp after you place the order.
faq.q5: Can I order a card or medallion with a custom design?
faq.a5: Of course! Write your design & logo details in the notes field of the order form, and our team will confirm with you before production.
faq.q6: Do these products work on any phone?
faq.a6: The NFC chip works on all modern phones (Android & iOS from iPhone XS onward). If your device lacks NFC, the QR code on the product opens the same page normally.
